name: Coke La Rock
hook: Talked over Kool Herc's records at the first party and is widely called the first MC, having released nothing and been credited for less.
blurb: Coke La Rock was Kool Herc's friend and got on the microphone at Herc's parties from 1973. At first he did not even have a stage name and stood out of sight, so the crowd had no idea who was talking. What he said was mostly shout-outs to people he knew in the room, which is where rapping starts: not as poetry, but as one person naming his friends over a record. Phrases he used turned up later on 'Rapper's Delight', the first rap hit, with no credit to him. He is the clearest example on this map of founding work that produced no property. What he did came before the record business got involved in hip-hop, was made up on the spot in rooms nobody was taping for release, and reached records through phrases other people sold. He is here for what he started, and the fact that he has no discography is the interesting part of his story, not a gap in the data.
signatureTracksNote: He rapped live at Kool Herc's parties and released no records of his own.
